help.blank: What’s your ___ on working from home?

expressions.pattern: ^(?:whats|what is) your (?:take|opinion|view) on (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,6})$|^how do you feel about (?<y>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,6})$
expressions.accept_note: ‘What do you think about …?’(3단계 표현)은 부분.

ok: What’s your take on working from home?
what is your opinion on online shopping
partial: what do you think about homework

help.blank: The main ___ is that I save time.

expressions.pattern: ^(?:the main reason is|the biggest reason is|mainly because|its mainly because)(?: that)? (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){1,14})$

ok: The main reason is that I save time.

help.blank: For ___, I don’t have to commute.

ok: For example, I don’t have to commute.
for instance I can cook lunch at home

scene.en: Moa, what’s your take on working from home?
I love it. The main reason is that I save so much time.
Sometimes I feel lonely. For example, I miss lunch with my team.
I get that. What’s your take on a four-day week?
Great idea! The main reason is that people need rest.
